value.heading: Mail your donation to:
value.text:
Thank you so much for donating! We will put your gift to work right away.
If you have any questions, please call us at 417-312-7484.

Thank you for your consideration and donation to Heartland Canines For Veterans. Your donation allows us to help those who have done so much for all of us, the US Veterans by providing them with a properly trained and certified Service Dog. Heartland Canines For Veterans is an IRS recognized 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. IRS EIN 47-4991572. All donations are tax deductible to the extent allowed by law. Consult your CPA if you have questions.
